title: ProjectE per-measurement lab record (L3 input)
description: The INPUT contract of tools/scripts/lab/physical_measurement.py: one record per measurement a bench, instrument or accredited lab actually took. This file describes evidence arriving from OUTSIDE the flow - the tool that reads it drives no instrument and takes no measurement of its own. Every field here exists because its absence is a specific way for a number to look like evidence without being evidence: an uncalibrated reading, a measurement of a different board, a setup nobody can repeat, a Touchstone with no reference plane, a pre-compliance screen wearing a compliance label. The reader's Python is authoritative for the cross-field rules (unit binding against the accepted first article, digest verification against the raw capture, interval comparison against the supplied limit); this file documents the shape.

rule_id.$comment: The D row this measurement is offered against, as dogrulama-matrisi names it. A record whose rule_id matches no row is not evidence for anything; it is simply not counted.

evidence_origin.$comment: Only physical evidence closes an L3 row. A TOOL_REPORT does not become physical by being copied into this file.

measurement_class.$comment: rail_sequence / thermal / tdr / vna / sparam / near_field / esd / functional ... Must match the rule's declared class; a thermal number offered against a TDR row is INVALID_METRIC, not a near miss. tdr/vna/sparam/touchstone additionally require the S-parameter block below.

board_hash.$comment: Must equal the accepted unit's board_hash. A measurement of a different board is not weaker evidence about this one - it is no evidence about this one, hence STALE rather than a warning.

calibration_id.$comment: Uncalibrated is not measured; it is read. Absence is NO_COVERAGE, not a slightly worse number.

setup.$comment: Probe, distance, angle, RBW, cable position, torque - whatever makes the run repeatable. emc-esd/SKILL.md §8: a setup that was not written down cannot be repeated, so it is not evidence.

reference_plane.$comment: Mandatory for TDR/VNA/S-parameter evidence (highspeed-routing/SKILL.md §6). Where the measurement claims to start.

load_state.$comment: What the board was doing. A thermal number at an unstated load point is a number about an unstated experiment.

baseline_id.$comment: REQUIRED when compliance_class is pre_compliance. The only meaningful pre-compliance quantity is the before/after difference in the same setup; an absolute dBuV with no baseline is not even a screen.

port_map.$comment: S-parameter block, all of it mandatory for tdr/vna/sparam/touchstone: port_map, reference_impedance, fixture, deembed_method, measurement_zone, reference_plane. Missing any of them is INVALID_SPARAM. Not a new rule - highspeed-routing/SKILL.md:349-351 already states it and names this exact outcome; this record is where it becomes enforceable.

deembed_method.$comment: DECLARED, never inferred - the same discipline sim/correlate.py applies. An un-de-embedded launch moves both magnitude and delay, and no residual separates that from the thing being measured.

units.$comment: Must equal the limit's units. Comparing two different quantities is arithmetic whose answer looks exactly like a real one.

uncertainty.$comment: Zero is a legitimate value and must be WRITTEN DOWN. Absence is not zero: the comparison widens the value by uncertainty + guard_band, and a margin inside that interval is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

raw_data_path.$comment: Touchstone / CSV / thermal capture / scope trace, relative to --raw-root. With --raw-root given, the file is hashed and a mismatch against raw_data_sha256 means the record and the capture are not the same measurement.

compliance_class.$comment: NO DEFAULT. The whole point of the field is that a screen and a signoff must not be able to look alike. pre_compliance is always SCREEN_ONLY and is never compared with a formal limit; accredited_lab additionally requires lab_artifact.

lab_artifact.$comment: The accredited laboratory's own report/profile reference. Declaring the class is not the same as holding the document; without it the row is CONFIRM.

$comment: Rules this schema CANNOT express, enforced only by physical_measurement.py: board_revision/board_hash/serial/lot must all equal the accepted first article's; the record's measurement_class must equal the rule's; units must equal the limit's units; raw_data_sha256 must match the file under --raw-root; the value is compared as an interval widened by uncertainty + guard_band; and there is NO field anywhere in this file that carries a limit - the limit arrives with the rule universe, carrying its own authority, or the row is NO_COVERAGE.
